/* 01 — about */

The mind
behind the code

I'm Sanchari Karmakar — a recently graduated BSc. CSE from City University, Bangladesh. I'm an IT Project Manager and Software Developer with a passion for building systems that work smarter and teams that deliver.

I specialize in IT Project Management — applying Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies to lead workflows and coordinate teams effectively. On the tech side, I build full-stack web applications using the MERN stack, Firebase, and Cloudinary.

I'm also an expert in AI automation using Claude and Gemini — designing intelligent workflows and LLM-powered pipelines. My background in HR, Recruitment, and Administration gives me a strong foundation in organizational operations.
